He does live farther away."; "No; Scott is wrong. It is Greg who lives father away."; "Both live the same distance from the school."; botão Hint; botão Done. Os passos do aluno são ações NESSES componentes (dividir cada reta, marcar cada ponto, escolher a alternativa, concluir).
